name: gaia-skill-heaven
description: The Claude Code plugin marketplace for gaia-skill-heaven — the Skill Heaven umbrella runtime brand. It ships claude-zero, the Skill Zero launcher door, while keeping /skill-hell framed as the live Hell summon door under the same umbrella.

plugins.name: claude-zero
plugins.description: Working prototype of the Claude Code door to Skill Zero under the Skill Heaven umbrella, actively tested for public use — there is one ladder, one line (off · low · med · high · xhigh · max · ultra) whose four surfaces are contiguous bands read from the rung: off is /skill-zero (owns boot-time off|low|med and ships /summon by default), low·med is /skill-heaven (converge), high·xhigh·max is /skill-hell (explore) — two directions of the same summon over one MCP — and ultra is /skill-ultra, the crown rung and controller with no sub-ladder of its own (PROVISIONAL counts/defaults), with /skill-hell as the live Hell summon door. Interfaces may change. Built on skill-zero core.
